annotation.title_clean: Tipifica na lei penal a alteração de fotos, vídeos e som com o uso de sistema de Inteligência Artificial para praticar violência contra a mulher (PL n.477/2024)
annotation.title_en: Criminalizes in penal law the alteration of photos, videos and sound using Artificial Intelligence systems to commit violence against women (Bill No. 477/2024)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Saullo Vianna, União/AM)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian federal bill PL 477/2024 would add Article 216-C to the Penal Code. The new article would criminalize altering or manipulating photos, videos or sound with AI or other means to cause humiliation, harassment, threats or violence against women in domestic or family settings, punishable by 2–4 years' imprisonment and a fine.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 216-C to the Brazilian Penal Code criminalizing AI-enabled manipulation of photos, videos or sound against women
Applies to intent to cause embarrassment, humiliation, harassment, threat or violence in domestic/family context
Penalty of 2 to 4 years' imprisonment plus fine
Justification cites AI's role in spreading non-consensual content and gender violence
